title: Provision of Lightning Conductor at Amini Lighthouse
summary: Notice inviting quotation for installing a copper lightning conductor and earthing on the trestle tower of Amini Lighthouse, Lakshadweep, with materials supplied by the department.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Gandhinagar, Kadavanthra P.O., Cochin

sites.name: Amini Lighthouse, P.O. Amini, UT of Lakshadweep, Pin 682552
sites.work: Installation of lightning conductor and earthing on trestle tower

scope.item: Earthing with copper earth plate 600mm x 600mm x 3mm incl. accessories, masonry enclosure with locking cover plate, 2.7m watering pipe, charcoal/coke and salt (without materials)
Excavation on surface alluvial soil for earth strip laying and refilling, removal and refixing of paver blocks with concreting, construction of earth pit chamber with materials
Providing and fixing double scaffolding system (cup lock type) up to seven storey height, 40mm dia M.S. tube

Labour charges for annealing copper strip & plate, fabrication of clamps, fabrication of GI pipe C class 2m with flange/base plate & top cover for air conductor, misc. civil works, soldering earth connections
Fixing of 25x6mm prefabricated copper clamps along trestle tower and copper earth strip on each clamp incl. brazing joints
Transportation charges for all items from Deep Bhavan, Cochin to Amini Lighthouse through courier (materials provided by department)

money.performance_security: FDR equivalent to 10% of the tendered amount
money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR from any Nationalised/RBI approved bank in favour of The Director, Directorate of Lighthouses & Lightships, Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; Small Scale Industries with valid NSIC/MSME certificate exempt. 100% payment within 30 days of satisfactory completion. Rates to show basic cost and taxes separately.

period.completion: 90 days from the date of supply/work order
period.bid_validity: 90 days from the date of opening of quotations

eligibility: Reputed OEMs or their authorized suppliers, licensed electrical contractors, parties or Government undertakings
Company/service engineers with minimum 3 years' experience in the relevant field
Work experience of equivalent or higher value (supply orders/work completion)
Last 3 years income tax returns, PAN card, GST registration certificate, NSIC/MSME certificate or EMD
Bidder to obtain permits for personnel to Amini, Agatti & Kavaratti islands from Lakshadweep Administration and ship tickets at own cost
specs: Copper strip 25mm x 6mm annealed at site for aerial conductor/earth tape along one main leg of trestle tower
1.5m long copper air electrode with spikes (heavy duty) on GI pole
GI pipe C class, 2m length, with GI flange/base plate and top cover, fixed with 12mm GI bolt; zinc primer and 2 coats synthetic enamel
Copper strip in 40mm dia GI pipe (medium) to earth electrode at 0.5m below ground
Copper earth plate 600mm x 600mm x 3mm with 2.7m watering pipe, charcoal/coke and salt/backfill compound
ER test of lightning conductor and earthing; works to relevant Indian standards
notes: Pages 9-11 are schematic/clamp drawings (not scale) with no text values. Quotation format download 23.11.2024 09:00 to 03.12.2024 14:00; sealed quotation and EMD 23.11.2024 14:00 to 03.12.2024 15:00; opening 04.12.2024 16:00. L1 on consolidated lowest total. Materials supplied by department.
